name: json_schema_validate
description: Validate a JSON value against a JSON Schema. Returns BOOLEAN — true if the value conforms. Implements the JSON Schema 2020-12 specification.

examples.description: Validate a row of JSON against a schema
examples.code: SELECT json_schema_validate(:schema, payload) AS ok FROM events;

name: json_schema_validate_schema
description: Validate that a JSON Schema is itself well-formed and conforms to the JSON Schema meta-schema. Use to lint your contracts before applying them.

name: json_schema_patch
description: Compute the JSON-Patch (RFC 6902) operations that would bring the input JSON into conformance with the schema's `default` values. Apply with DuckDB's JSON functions to fill in missing fields.

examples.description: Generate the patch for a partial document
examples.code: SELECT json_schema_patch(:schema, payload) AS patch FROM events;
